finding: FUZZ-M10-24H-D-B (the KI-66 full / KI-67 head's 24 h run D at 55b3e23, `run --profile all --duration 24h --jobs 4 --actions 400 --seed 71000000`, 1 in 31,389 runs; harness, not program): an anomaly, not a failure. In the never-returns wind-down (KI-66) curve seed 71017971 (`one --profile curve --seed 71017971 --actions 400`, 378 actions) left the present lenders owed 73,744,534,723 lamports while the oracle bounded them by the absent lender's surplus moves (0), CLAIM_DUST per present lender and the carry gap (2,002). The absent lender (behind the epoch-0 rebase record, 13,557,141,569,087,019 shares, a forward chain of 13,557) had `pending` −73,744,535,218: an S3 settlement realised ≈ 4.8 SOL of a ≈ 930 SOL credited receivable, and the shortfall was debited pro rata to the shares holding then (`acc_end` −28,851,400,694,912 against the lender's snapshot 12,130,371,237,810: −555,595,683,844 against its +481,851,148,626 credit), so the lenders that had withdrawn more of their shares earlier kept a positive `pending` that only this lender's `cover_deficit` pays in (KI-53). The third party's hold, the owner's signed conversion (on VM copies before and after the chain: the same lender, pot 2,901,992,573 and present lenders' claims) and `pool_model` on the extracted state book exactly that; the epoch-1 chain accrued 0. When the owner returns it covers (the deficit tripwire: 73.7 SOL within its bound) and the second claim pass pays every lender. Minimised from the 378-action run by `tmin` with the anomaly made a panic (63 actions: owed 322,230,772 lamports, bound 1,002). Replay: `shortwin-fuzz replay tests/fuzz/corpus/fuzz-m10-24h-d-b-curve-absent-deficit.json`.
resolution: Resolved in the fuzzer, no program change: `World::absent_owners_out` bounds the present lenders' unpaid total by what the absent owners' return brings to the pot — their touches' surplus moves plus the deficits those touches leave them (the cover reaches the pot at the owner's next touch) plus the pot — less what the absent lenders are owed beyond their own realised SOL (their claims draw on the same inflows), plus CLAIM_DUST per lender and the carry gap (`World::absent_returns`); `wind-down-absent-deficit` counts the markets whose bound holds a deficit. On this reproducer (two absent lenders owing 349,170,527 and owed 26,939,646 lamports; the present lenders owed 322,230,772) the bound is 3,111 lamports above the owed total, and a 10,000-lamport leak fires it (`smoke::absent_deficit_backs_the_present_lenders`, `world::ABSENT_OWED_LEAK`). The economics are KI-53. This file replays as a regression: the run must pass and must not report its `anomaly` (`corpus_replays`).
